mediaId.title: MediaId
mediaId.description: Exact provider resource identity. The canonical form is portos-media://portpowered.com/provider/media-type/resource-kind/resource-id, with no URI version. Spotify emits audio track, playlist, album, artist, show and episode identities. Copy an ID returned by search or library discovery; do not send a search phrase as an ID. Legacy providers retain their own input contracts until explicitly migrated. See https://portpowered.com/docs/media.
